run_inference_test: run object detection inference on test datasets using a config file and checkpoint
run_distributed_inference: run distributed object detection inference across multiple GPUs using WORLD_SIZE and local_rank
run_inference_with_checkpoint: run inference test with a specific checkpoint file path using the --ckpt argument
run_inference_with_config_override: run inference test and override config options via command-line opts arguments
run_inference_with_mixed_precision: run inference test with mixed precision enabled by setting DTYPE to float16 in config
